senses.definition: To bring into a group, class, set, or total as a (new) part or member.
examples: I will purchase the vacation package if you will include car rental.

senses.definition: To consider as part of something; to comprehend.
examples: The vacation package includes car rental.
Does this volume of Shakespeare include his sonnets?
I was included in the invitation to the family gathering.
up to and including page twenty-five

senses.definition: (programming) To use a directive that allows the use of source code from another file.
examples: You have to include the strings library to use this function.

senses.definition: (programming) A piece of source code or other content that is dynamically retrieved for inclusion in another item.
